messages.content: Please check whether the NYSE is open, then look up the current price for AAPL. If a quote is available, use it to sell 10 shares of AAPL for trader_id user_99, and note the currency as EUR. After that, get the current New York time and post an update to my US market board, board_id poly_01, with high priority. Then create a Trade Execution Report that includes the execution time, and email me the notification as well.
